items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: We used to play Make Me a Pallet on the Floor, Think Heard, Butter, Bold, and Save, and quite a few more that I can't recall, you know, old numbers.

ctx.x: That's right. What tunes did you play with that band? Hmm? What tunes did you play then?
We used to play Make Me a Pallet on the Floor, Think Heard, Butter, Bold, and Save, and quite a few more that I can't recall, you know, old numbers. Uh-huh.
Did you play waltzes and things like that?
